-- Spec: a seeded shuffle of a list of ints.
-- Output is a permutation of the input; the order depends only on seed.
-- No capabilities are granted.

shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre seed >= 0
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([1], 3) == [1]
  var out = copy xs
  var state = seed % 2147483648
  for k in range(0, xs.len())
    let i = xs.len() - 1 - k
    state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
    let j = state % (i + 1)
    let tmp = out[i]
    out[i] = out[j]
    out[j] = tmp
  out
